description: Inundation Analysis Tool is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NOAA Center for Operational Oceanographic Products and Services (CO-OPS). Coastal storms and other meteorological phenomenon can have a significant impact on how high water levels rise and how often. The inundation analysis tool can display the observed frequency and duration of tidal waters reaching a specific threshold. Statistical output from these analyses can be useful in planning marsh restoration activities. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Erosion and Shoreline Recession, Flooding – Coastal. Assets: Natural Areas and Wildlife, Property. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
